meta.name: init-first-agent
meta.description: Walk the operator through wiring the first NanoClaw agent to a DM channel — resolve the operator's channel identity, select or create the agent, and trigger a welcome DM via the normal delivery path. Use after channel credentials are configured and the service is running.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把首个智能体接入私信频道并发出欢迎消息
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你刚布置好智能体服务,想快速接通私信频道。
copy.tagline_en: Connect your first agent to a DM channel and send a welcome message
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you've just set up an agent service and want to quickly wire it to a DM channel.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会引导你为第一个 NanoClaw agent 完成接线:解析你在频道里的身份、把 DM 消息组接到新 agent,并让它通过正常投递路径给你发一条欢迎私信。重复运行也安全。
howto.when: 在频道凭据已配置、服务已运行之后,你要求为某个 DM 频道创建第一个 agent 时触发。

say.text: 帮我在 Discord 上初始化第一个 agent,并让它给我发一条欢迎私信。
say.note: 会创建 agent 并排队发出欢迎私信。

say.text: 用 Telegram 作为频道创建第一个 agent,名字叫小白。
say.note: 也可先走 Telegram 配对码路径。

say.text: 欢迎私信没收到,帮我看看是不是卡在 outbound 队列里。
say.note: 会检查 outbound.db 和日志。

howto.what_en: After install, Claude walks you through wiring your first NanoClaw agent: it resolves your channel identity, connects the DM messaging group to a new agent, and triggers a welcome DM through the normal delivery path. Rerunning is safe.
howto.when_en: Use once channel credentials are configured and the service is running, when you ask to create the first agent for a DM channel.

say_en.text: Set up my first agent on Discord and have it DM me a welcome message.
say_en.note: Creates the agent and queues the welcome DM.

say_en.text: Create my first agent on Telegram, agent name 小白.
say_en.note: Uses Telegram's pair-code path if you'd rather not DM first.

say_en.text: The welcome DM didn't arrive — check whether it's stuck in the outbound queue.
say_en.note: Checks outbound.db and the log for delivery errors.
